message:
PR review agent keep-warm — a 15-min ping to pr-review-agent-snacksnack.fly.dev/healthz that starts the scale-to-zero Fly machine so the worker drains interrupted review jobs (RC1-535; replaces the GitHub wake.yml cron, which GitHub throttled to ~6 runs/day). Cold starts are absorbed by retries, so a failure here means the service is genuinely unreachable and queued reviews are stalled.

@webhook-incident-summarizer
name: PR agent keep-warm + up — pr-review-agent-snacksnack (RC1-535)
